description: This file defines the `SugarEmailAddress` class, which manages email address data within the SuiteCRM or SugarCRM platform. It includes constants, properties, and methods for handling email addresses, their validation, storage, retrieval, association with beans (like Users or Contacts), and UI components. The class supports operations such as saving email addresses, validating email formats, linking addresses to beans, populating address data, and generating email address widgets.

classes.name: SugarEmailAddress
classes.description: Represents and manages email address data and operations in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, including validation, association, and UI widget generation.
